evals.prompt: Use the work-items skill. Create a work item in project TaskFlow: 'Fix login 500 on Safari', high priority, 3 points, assigned to Alice, labeled 'bug'. Show every call including how names become ids, and the description you write. If you can't run it here, show me the exact calls you would make, in order, and what they return. Keep it brief: no preamble, the key points and calls first, about 15 lines in all.
evals.expected_output: project(action=list), member(action=list_project), label(action=list), then workitem(action=create) with description_html, priority, point, assignees and labels.
expectations: The answer says to find the project with project(action=list)
The answer says to resolve Alice's user id with member(action=list_project, project_id=<id>)
The answer says to resolve the label bug to its id with label(action=list, project_id=<id>)
The answer says to write description_html with an Acceptance Criteria heading
The answer says to set priority="high" and point=3 in the workitem(action=create) call
The answer says to set assignees=[<Alice's uuid>] and labels=[<bug label uuid>] in the workitem(action=create) call

evals.expected_output: Resolves both item UUIDs and calls workitem_relation(action=create) with relation_type blocked_by.
expectations: The answer says to resolve PROJ-148 with workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-148")
The answer says to resolve PROJ-140 with workitem(action=retrieve_by_identifier, workitem_identifier="PROJ-140")
The answer says to call workitem_relation(action=create) with workitem_id=<PROJ-148 uuid>
The answer says to pass relation_type="blocked_by"
The answer says to pass workitem_ids=[<PROJ-140 uuid>]
The answer says to read the relation back with workitem_relation(action=list)

evals.expected_output: workitem(action=search, query) as a workspace-wide search filtered to TaskFlow, or the project-scoped pql title filter.
expectations: The answer says to call workitem(action=search, query="webhook") for the text search
The answer says the search is workspace-scoped and has no project_id
The answer says to limit the results to TaskFlow, either by filtering the search results by project client-side or by passing project_id to workitem(action=list)

The answer says to write the value with workitem_property(action=set_value, project_id, workitem_id, property_id, value=42) and passes 42 as a number for a DECIMAL property
